about: Titles (docs/design/skills-v2.md §11, as the owner's answers of order 82 change it: §15; D-183): the words a title is written in. tools/lint-titles.mjs validates data/titles/ against this file; src/people/9999976-titles reads it. A title's conditions are never shown to the player.
rarityNote: No common titles. 'unique' is not a rarity but a flag: one living holder at a time (the owner, order 82: the word only for what is one of a kind). A unique title spends a quarter more, a legendary one half more (the larger when both).
budgetNote: A title spends at most perLevel(weight) x 5 (half a skill at Lv 10: D 5, C 10, B 20, A 40, S 80) on its person effects, priced with data/skills/vocab.json's costs. Weight X is the great beings' (above SSS): no person effects, only the beings' buffs that A.POWER reads.
statNote: At most +3 on one stat a title; skills' and titles' stat effects together at most +10 on one stat (the adapter's cap) and never past the body's potential by more than 5 (A.stat).
fieldsNote: A title: id, name (may hold {place} or {realm}), rarity, weight, unique (one living holder), per ('realm': one holder in each realm), once (given once an age), since (only for what is reached after the age began: whoever met its conditions when titles came into the world is written down and never earns it), grant ('ruler': the realm's ruler names him, through A.WHY), kind, beings, born (held from birth), holders (the great beings whose sheets name it), class (a title that is also a class: the Sword Saint), requires and watch (hidden), lose (the deeds that take it away), effects (the skills' vocabulary, for people), buffs (capabilities, level and power, for the great beings: A.POWER), honour and renown (paid once), hint, earned and lost (the world's words), style (beside the name), text, reasons (what it gives a decider, by kind of decision).
socialNote: social: how a group of people regards the holder, in points of opinion (A.opinion adds it: the best group the viewer belongs to, at most +10). faith: those of the holder's own faith.
predicateNote: count: { count: kind, min?, max?, distinct? } over the ledger (distinct: that many different keys, such as realms); streak: { streak: kind, min } (the run since a deed that breaks it); best: { best: kind, min } (the largest value one deed carried, such as a siege's days); skill: { fam, rank, lv? } (a family's rung, 'any' for the best); has: a title id held; age: [min, max]; race and faith: lists; stat: { str: 60 }; fame, honor: a minimum; flag: a flag set; only: { measure: a skill key, scope: 'realm' } (the best living by it in his realm); ruling: { kind, years } (one of the kind's keys is a living ruler who has sat a year since the deed). A unique title is free only while no living person or great being holds it (the census). Nothing reads the dice.

duel_won.src: A.duelConsequences: a duel, a brawl or a tourney bout won (not a spar), for the player and, when he loses, for his foe

duel_lost.src: A.duelConsequences: a fight lost or yielded (not a spar), for the player and for a foe he beats

champion_beaten.src: A.duelConsequences: a duel won against a realm's champion (a holder of a fighting title or a tourney's winner, or a commander of its host); key: his realm

beast_slain.src: A.duelConsequences (a beast killed in a hunt or a fight), PW.resolve (a beast killed outright); value: its level

beast_above.src: as beast_slain, when the beast's level stood above the slayer's

dragon_slain.src: as beast_slain, for a beast of dragon kind (the bestiary's dragons and wyrms, the release's two dragons)

wound_serious.src: A.addWound: a lasting wound (perm, or two years and more to heal), anyone

battle.src: the three places a soldier's battles are counted (the line, the company, the division)

battle_wounded.src: as battle, when a serious wound came in the same month

battle_won.src: A.fightEnd through A.LV.field: a commander of a winning division in a field battle

siege_held.src: A.siegeTick: a besieged walled place whose siege was given up after it had stood; for its lord (the seat's holder) or the player if he served in it; value: the days it stood

treaty_made.src: A.endWar: a war ended by terms, for each side's ruler, and for the player when he ruled a side or carried its embassy

faith_kept.src: a card's choice (choices below): faith held under threat of prison, torture or death

town_put_to_sword.src: a card's choice (choices below); key: the place

tourney_won.src: the release's deed line 'Champion of ...' (a tourney won), read each month

king_made.src: the release's deed lines of a crown won for another (none yet: the realm's peace W1-6 will call A.deedDone when a claimant the player backed is crowned); key: the ruler

pupil_taught.src: a class's teaching activity done well (src/people/9999975-level/c-classes.core.js: Teach the sword for pay, Drill the young spears, Keep a fencing hall; D-184); the training screen later (skills-v2 §12.3)

choices.note: Cards whose choices are deeds a title watches: ev, and on: { choice index: deed kind } (the index in the event's own list of choices). win: true counts a choice with a check only when it succeeds. key: the card's ctx token that names the place.

seriousNote: The wounds a fight, a beast or a battle leaves (GD.WOUNDS keys): a strain, a brand or a cough is not counted.
strengthNote: What a title gives, in words (no numbers for the player): the sum of its effects' costs.
